description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractRule' within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically in the EndpointV2 module. It provides a base for rule objects that contain conditions and documentation, and methods to evaluate those conditions in the context of ruleset standard library.

classes.name: AbstractRule
classes.description: An abstract class representing a rule with conditions and documentation used within AWS EndpointV2 ruleset processing.

methods.name: getConditions
methods.description: Returns the list of conditions for this rule.

methods.name: getDocumentation
methods.description: Returns the documentation associated with this rule.

methods.name: evaluateConditions
methods.description: Evaluates all conditions of the rule using the provided standard library and input parameters. Returns true if all are met, false otherwise.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: An abstract method to evaluate the rule given input parameters and the standard library. Must be implemented by subclasses.
